title: Geometry-Aided Channel Deduction with Partial Channel Estimates and Uncalibrated Digital Twin
abstract: arXiv:2609.37277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The acquisition of high-dimensional channel state information (CSI) in wireless MIMO-OFDM communications usually requires high pilot overhead, or relies on accurate and complete positional or environmental information. In this paper, we propose a geometry-aided channel deduction (GCD) approach, which utilizes an uncalibrated digital twin (DT) with only approximate environmental geometry and positions to assist the channel acquisition. The key rationale behind is that, even imprecise geometric information, which can be easily obtained in advance through radio sensing technologies or existing geographic databases, provides certain structural features about the current channel; meanwhile, the coarse instantaneous channel estimates using only a small amount of pilots provide dedicated information that aligns with the channel structure and further compensates for the geometry inaccuracy and other channel unknowns. tldr: 本文提出一种几何辅助信道推断（GCD）方法，通过将仅含近似环境几何信息的未校准数字孪生与少量导频获得的粗略部分信道估计相结合，以低导频开销实现无线MIMO-OFDM系统中高维信道状态信息的获取。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a geometry-aided channel deduction (GCD) approach that combines an uncalibrated digital twin with approximate environmental geometry and coarse partial channel estimates from few pilots, enabling low-overhead acquisition of high-dimensional CSI in wireless MIMO-OFDM communications.
